description: This file defines the QueueManager class responsible for managing Redis queues, including setup, retrieval, and integration with Bull Board for monitoring. It handles queue registration, connection configuration, and queue setup with dependencies like PredictionQueue and UpsertQueue.

classes.name: QueueManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing Redis queues, including setup, retrieval, and monitoring via Bull Board.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of QueueManager.

methods.name: registerQueue
methods.description: Registers a queue with a given name.

methods.name: getQueue
methods.description: Retrieves a registered queue by name.

methods.name: getPredictionQueueEventsProducer
methods.description: Returns the QueueEventsProducer for prediction queues.

methods.name: getBullBoardRouter
methods.description: Returns the Express router for Bull Board.

methods.name: getAllJobCounts
methods.description: Fetches job counts for all registered queues.

methods.name: setupAllQueues
methods.description: Initializes prediction and upsert queues, sets up Bull Board if serverAdapter is provided.
